text.p: United States-owned power company NRG Australia Ltd said on Thursday it planned to increase its industry investments in Australia through acquisitions and greenfield developments.
Managing director and chief executive officer David Scaysbrook said there was at present no formal limit on NRG's appetite for investments in the Australian energy industry.
NRG Australia is a subsidiary of Northern States Power Co, based in the U.S. state of Minnesota.

Addressing the Electricity Supply Association of Australia Ltd annual conference here, Scaysbrook said Brisbane-based NRG Australia ranked Australia as its number one country priority in the Asia Pacific, with Indonesia following close behind.
NRG Australia had successfully used its Brisbane base since establishment in 1993 as a springboard to Asia, he said.
